newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher, seen consolidating.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end higher, seen consolidating.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures clambered higher in late Monday trade to finish above the key 21,000-points level after reversing their early decline.
But dealers said the market's upside was likely to be limited as activity slowed ahead of Japan's general election on October 20.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 10 points below an intra-day high of 21,150 against a previous settlement at 21,000.
Market turnover was a measly 11,410 lots as volume on the underlying cash market in Tokyo also tumbled to a new year low.
"I think there'll be a correction soon but the momentum still shows an uptrend," said a chartist with a local brokerage.
He said the December Nikkei was likely to be supported around 21,000-21,050 initially and then at 20,980 and 20,840.
